sentence: Even partisan politics enters: the market's reward for sustainability-conscious AI innovation grows under Democratic administrations
passage: [Singh et al. (2026), abstract] "The findings demonstrate that AI innovation increases firm value for companies that perform well on sustainability-related metrics. This effect is stronger under Democratic administrations than under Republican governments"

gemini.note: The passage explicitly states that the positive effect of AI innovation on firm value for sustainable companies is stronger under Democratic administrations, directly supporting the sentence.
